correctness.rationale: For H=J(S+S*)−iηP0 on ℓ²(Z), differentiate norm to get Q_m=2η∫_0∞|A_m(t)|²dt. Free lattice Green function and rank-one resolvent give Laplace amplitude ρ(s)^m/(η+√(s²+4J²)). L²-Plancherel on imaginary axis splits |ω|<2J source-independent band Q∞=η/π ∫_{−2J}^{2J}(η+√(4J²−ω²))^(−2)dω from an exterior-band strictly positive integral with e^(−2mu). Monotone Q_m↓Q∞ follows; expanding sinh integrand at u=0 yields m⁻² and m⁻⁴ coefficients with O(m⁻⁶). Substituting a=η/(2J) evaluates band integral; derivative is negative for a≥1, while for a∈(0,1) its sign equals (3−2k²)(atanh k−k)−k³ with k²=1−a². After division by k⁵, series has one negative constant and strictly positive higher coefficients, strictly increases to infinity; thus one global critical η/J≈1.225741123666 and Q∞≈0.222796320563. Independent spectral quadrature and optimization checks corroborate.
